What We Do

You focus on your factory. We handle the complete process of international sales development for you

01

Market Research & Buyer Prospecting

Identifying the right export markets and the overseas buyers most likely to want what you make.

02

Value Proposition & Positioning

Framing your product and your factory in a way that speaks directly to an international buyer's concerns.

03

Negotiation & Order Closing

Handling buyer conversations, objections, and terms — all the way through to a confirmed order.

04

Documentation & Logistics

Coordinating between your assigned staff and CHA and Shipping liners for smooth transaction.

What we never touch: your product pricing. That decision — and the process control— stays entirely with you.
